controls.name: Immutable Evidence Retention
controls.description: Control evidence is written to object-locked storage with version identifiers, hash validation, retention policy, and graph edge traceability.

mappings.rationale: Immutable evidence proves monitoring outcomes and decision traceability.

fairScenario.source_notes: S3 Object Lock configuration checks, evidence hash verification, and audit package retrieval tests.

controls.name: Production Change Management
controls.description: Production changes require approval, linked tickets, testing evidence, and emergency change review.

mappings.rationale: Change approvals and linked tickets satisfy change management.

controls.name: Encryption at Rest
controls.description: Sensitive data stores use approved encryption at rest with managed keys and monitored configuration drift.

mappings.rationale: Encryption and key controls are continuously checked.
Key management coverage is strong but needs PCI-specific custodian evidence.

controls.name: Centralized Security Logging
controls.description: Security-relevant system, identity, and cloud logs are centralized, retained, monitored, and available for investigation.

mappings.rationale: Central logs support monitoring of user and system activity.

controls.name: Endpoint Protection Coverage
controls.description: Managed endpoints run approved protection, report health, and automatically create remediation tasks for stale agents.

mappings.rationale: Endpoint posture is stale on a subset of devices.

fairScenario.scenario_name: Endpoint security gap enables malware spread
fairScenario.source_notes: Endpoint health exports, stale agent counts, and incident response containment assumptions.

controls.name: Identity Lifecycle Review
controls.description: Joiner, mover, and leaver access is reviewed against HR source-of-truth and deprovisioning evidence.

mappings.rationale: Unique workforce identities are linked to access review evidence.
Lifecycle reviews remove access when business need ends.

fairScenario.source_notes: HR JML records, Okta deprovisioning timestamps, and quarterly access-review exceptions.

controls.name: Privileged Access Management
controls.description: Administrative access to production systems is brokered through a managed vault, requires MFA, and records every privileged session.

mappings.rationale: Human privileged access is covered; service identities need an explicit subcontrol.
Identity and credentials are governed through vaulting and MFA.
PAM, MFA, and session recording strongly satisfy logical access requirements.

fairScenario.source_notes: Internal privileged session logs, MFA exception counts, and admin access review outcomes.

controls.name: Security Awareness Training
controls.description: Employees and privileged users complete security awareness training within policy-defined windows.

mappings.rationale: Training supports access responsibilities for privileged users.

controls.name: Business Continuity Exercise
controls.description: Critical services have documented recovery procedures and tested continuity exercises with tracked remediation.

controls.name: Protected Production Branches
controls.description: Production repositories enforce branch protection, required reviews, and restricted admin bypass.

mappings.rationale: Branch protections enforce review before production change.

controls.name: Tier 1 Vendor Security Review
controls.description: Tier 1 vendors are assessed before onboarding and annually thereafter using SOC 2, security questionnaire, breach history, and data processing scope.

mappings.rationale: Vendor assessment exists; continuous monitoring is not complete.

fairScenario.source_notes: Vendor assessment age, bridge-letter status, external rating movement, and data processing scope.

controls.name: Critical Vulnerability Remediation
controls.description: Critical vulnerabilities on internet-facing production assets are remediated or formally risk accepted within SLA.

mappings.rationale: Remediation workflow covers vulnerabilities but needs EOL replacement criteria.
Security findings are monitored, but SLA misses are currently degraded.

fairScenario.source_notes: Security Hub critical findings, SLA misses, internet exposure, and external exploit activity analogs.
